summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on the instability of Rundeck, specifically regarding memory consumption due to loading entire day's worth of `device_session_concept` data. It was suggested that the job processing needs optimization to handle data in chunks rather than processing the entire time range at once. An alternative approach discussed involved using ClickHouse for both copying files and running jobs, although this would require maintaining node support within Rundeck.

It was noted that while Rundeck can run traffic jobs over arbitrarily large time ranges, doing so consumes a proportionally large amount of RAM, making it risky to deploy such jobs on critical servers.
decisions: The job processing needs optimization to handle data in chunks.
action_items: Someone needs to rewrite the traffic job logic to process data in parts (chunks).
